name: Mana Community - DPDP Act 2023 Resident Data Consent & Purpose Sentinel

parameters.jsCode:
const item = $input.first().json.body || $input.first().json;
const prompt = "You are an AI data protection officer specializing in India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDP Act 2023).
You audit resident consent records for biometric gate entry, facial recognition ANPR, child activity tracking, and purpose limitation expiry.
Analyze the input payload:
__DATA__

Respond strictly with valid JSON conforming to this schema:
{
  "dpdpComplianceRating": "COMPLIANT",
  "consentHealthScore": 94,
  "expiringConsentsCount": 3,
  "minorDataConsentsVerified": true,
  "purposeLimitationBreachesDetected": false,
  "actionableFindings": [
    "Biometric gate pass consent for Flat B-302 tenant expires in 7 days",
    "Verified parental consent on record for under-18 badminton tournament roster"
  ],
  "recommendedNoticeWorkflow": "DISPATCH_RECONSENT_SMS",
  "statutoryClauseReferenced": "DPDP Act 2023 Section 6(1) - Notice and Consent Specifications",
  "auditTimestamp": "2026-11-21T08:30:00Z"
}";
return [{ json: { prompt: prompt.replace("__DATA__", JSON.stringify(item, null, 2)), originalInput: item } }];
